from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record for one provided paper extracted from the document being parsed."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being parsed")
    references_to_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of the OTHER provided papers found in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationRecord]
